description: This file implements a flash disk driver for Zephyr RTOS, managing flash memory operations including initialization, read, write, cache management, and device registration.

methods.name: disk_flash_access_status
methods.description: Checks the status of the disk, returning no media if device is not present.

methods.name: flashdisk_init_runtime
methods.description: Initializes runtime parameters for the flash disk, including page size and layout verification.

methods.name: disk_flash_access_init
methods.description: Initializes the disk by opening the flash area and setting up device parameters.

methods.name: sectors_in_range
methods.description: Verifies if specified sectors are within the disk's partition boundary.

methods.name: disk_flash_access_read
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory, utilizing cache if valid.

methods.name: flashdisk_cache_commit
methods.description: Commits cached data to flash if dirty.

methods.name: flashdisk_cache_load
methods.description: Loads a flash page into cache for read/write operations.

methods.name: flashdisk_cache_write
methods.description: Writes data to cache, marking it as dirty.

methods.name: disk_flash_access_write
methods.description: Writes data to flash memory, handling partial and full page writes with cache management.

methods.name: disk_flash_access_ioctl
methods.description: Handles control commands such as sync, get sector count, size, and erase block size.

methods.name: disk_flash_init
methods.description: Registers all flash disk devices during system initialization.
